seoTitle: Set Up Subscription Payment Plans on Stripe (2026)
metaDescription: Create subscription products, configure recurring monthly or annual pricing, and test billing in Stripe before switching your store to live mode.
intro: Subscriptions power everything from SaaS tools to membership sites, and Stripe makes the underlying billing manageable if you set it up in the right order. This guide walks through creating a subscription product, configuring recurring pricing, connecting it to checkout, and testing the whole flow safely before going live.

steps.heading: Create a subscription product in Stripe
steps.body: Start by setting up a product specifically intended for recurring billing, which forms the basis for your subscription plan.

steps.heading: Set up recurring pricing options
steps.body: Choose a billing interval such as monthly or annual, so Stripe knows how often to charge subscribers automatically.

steps.heading: Integrate subscription checkout
steps.body: Connect the subscription price to your checkout page so customers can sign up and start their billing cycle directly.

steps.heading: Test in Test Mode, then switch to Live Mode
steps.body: Run through the subscription flow in Stripe's Test Mode to confirm everything works, then switch to Live Mode once you're confident before accepting real payments.

faq.question: What kinds of businesses benefit from Stripe subscriptions?
faq.answer: Subscriptions work well for memberships, SaaS products, digital products, or any service billed monthly or yearly.

faq.question: Can customers cancel their subscription themselves?
faq.answer: Cancellations and billing cycles can be managed from your Stripe dashboard, and the guide covers handling cancellations alongside invoices.

faq.question: Should I test subscriptions before going live?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe's Test Mode lets you simulate the full subscription flow so you can catch issues before switching to Live Mode.

faq.question: How do I switch from Test Mode to Live Mode?
faq.answer: Once you've confirmed your subscription setup works correctly in Test Mode, you toggle over to Live Mode in your Stripe dashboard to start accepting real payments.
